item.title: Mathematics Part 1: Complex Analysis
item.description: Why complex numbers solve real problems: a quick taste with a real integral, and the roadmap we will follow.

item.title: Quantum Mechanics Part 2: How Electrons Are Distributed
item.description: An intuitive exploration of how electrons occupy quantum states. From probability densities and Fermi–Dirac statistics to electron distributions in crystalline systems, this article reframes electrons as probabilistic entities rather than localized particles.

item.title: Quantum Mechanics Part 1: From Schrödinger to Wave Functions
item.description: Exploring the probabilistic nature of the quantum world. A derivation of the Schrödinger equation and visualization of wave functions using Python (Matplotlib).

item.title: Linear Systems Part 1: Fourier Transform & Laplace Transform
item.description: Unveiling the mathematical symmetry between Time and Frequency domains. A deep dive into why multiplication in one domain equals convolution in the other, and the mystery of spectrum replication.

item.title: Linear Systems Part 2: Laplace Transform
item.description: Unveiling the mathematical symmetry between Time and Frequency domains. A deep dive into why multiplication in one domain equals convolution in the other, and the mystery of spectrum replication.

item.title: Linear Systems Part 3: RLC Circuit Analysis: Differential Equations vs. Laplace Transform
item.description: Reflecting on the two distinct mathematical approaches to circuit analysis. Why do we shift from the tangible time domain to the abstract s-domain? A journey through the mathematical machinery of RLC circuits.
